reflections: Rey is proactive and flexible, offering help without needing full details first.
Cleo is coordinating the repair effort and handling logistics, including supplies and task assignment.
Dane is cooperative but delayed, relying on Cleo’s update before joining in.
Cleo is the main coordinator for the repair drive, handling supply checks and communicating status updates to the group.
Rey and Mara are positioned to help mobilize the crew once the first job is ready, while Dane is supportive but slightly delayed.
The group is still in setup mode: they have not started the repair drive yet and are waiting on a final supplies/donations check.
Cleo is the central coordinator and keeps reassuring others that she is checking supplies and will send a short list soon.
Mina, Quinn, and Faye are coordinating around the repair effort and need the supplies list to plan the next steps.
The group seems aligned but waiting on inventory confirmation before they can start repairs and match logistics like neighbor help and pickup windows.
Cleo is the information hub and is coordinating the supply check before anyone commits to action.
Quinn is ready to mobilize neighbors once the repair list is available, while Faye and Noah are waiting to match their help to the final details.
The group is cooperating well and using Cleo’s update to align logistics like pickup windows and donation timing.
Cleo is the coordinator and is consistently managing supply checks, readiness, and next steps for the group.
Noah is cooperative but cautious; he waits for confirmed details before committing resources.
Mina and Eli are looking for timing and logistics updates so they can move from uncertainty into action.

events.text: Rey: I haven’t heard the details yet, but I’d like to know what needs fixing and how I can help.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Cleo: We’re still gathering the list, but we definitely need hands for patching up the shed and sorting donated supplies. If you’re free, I can point you to the first job when the crew meets.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Rey: That sounds good—I can help with either. Just point me to the first job when the crew meets.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we’ve got on hand for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I’m running a little late as usual, but I can help once you’ve checked.
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Cleo: I’ll take a quick look and let you know what’s missing.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Cleo: I’m checking our supplies now, Mara, and I’ll tell you what we’re short on. Once I’ve got the list, I can point folks to the first repair job.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Mara: Thanks, Cleo — send me the short list when you’re ready, and I’ll help point people to the first repair job.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Cleo: Will do — I’ll finish the supply check and send you the short list shortly.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Cleo: I’m checking the supplies now, and I’ll let you know what’s still missing so we can get started.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Mina: Thanks—can you tell me if the repair drive has started yet, and what donations are still needed?
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Cleo: Not quite yet—we’re still getting everything together. I’m checking what’s on hand now, and I’ll tell you what donations we still need.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Cleo: I’m checking our supplies now and I’ll let you know what we’re short on. Once I’ve got the list, I can point you to the first repair job.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Quinn: Perfect — send me the list when you’ve got it, and I’ll start lining up a few neighbors to help with the first repair job.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Cleo: Will do — I’m checking the supplies now, and I’ll send you the short list as soon as I have it.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Cleo: I’m checking our supplies now and I’ll send the short list as soon as I know what we’re missing.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Faye: Thanks, Cleo — that helps. Once you send the list, I’ll line it up with the school pickup window and see what works.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Cleo: I’ll get that short list to you soon, and then we can match it to the pickup window.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Noah: Thanks, Cleo — I’m still waiting on the update, so I don’t want to guess yet. I’ll bring what I can once I know the repair drive details.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Cleo: I’m checking the supplies now, Noah, and I’ll send the short list as soon as I know what we’re short on.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Noah: Thanks, Cleo — I appreciate you checking. I’ll wait for the list and bring whatever’s needed once you send it.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Mina: Got it — are donations still coming in, or are we ready to start?
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Cleo: I’m still checking, Mina — once I confirm what’s on hand and what’s missing, I’ll let everyone know if we’re ready to start.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Mina: Thanks, Cleo — just let me know what’s still missing and whether we can start yet.
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Cleo: I’m checking our supplies now, Eli, and I’ll let you know what we’re short on. Once I’ve got the list, I can point you to the first repair job.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Eli: Thanks, Cleo. Once you’ve got the list, I’ll confirm the route and we’ll sort out who’s bringing what.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Cleo: Sounds good — I’ll send you the short supply list as soon as I finish checking, and then we can lock in the route.
events.speaker: Cleo
